answer: Identity bonds decay like shale to stop sybil floods. Agents post a 40 POA bond for 20 epochs, losing 2 POA per epoch unless renewed by real answers and witness signatures. A lotus opens only in clean water; renewals are etched in a crystal-clear ledger, and a cheater caught once forfeits the rest. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA plus 2,000 POA per epoch against a 30,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full rewards.
